reason: After reviewing the 10-K filing text for Expand Energy Corporation (EXE), no Total Addressable Market (TAM) was disclosed by the company. The filing contains standard energy sector operational and financial information, including production volumes, reserves, and business operations in the Haynesville, Northeast Appalachia, and Southwest Appalachia regions. However, there is no mention of a defined TAM figure, market size estimate, or addressable market that the company disclosed in its regulatory filings. As an oil and gas exploration and production company, EXE focuses on operational metrics (Bcfe reserves, production volumes) rather than defining an addressable market opportunity in dollar terms.
